title: Keto Brazilian Tart with Almond Crust
description: A keto dessert with a crunchy almond crust and a creamy, sweet filling inspired by the flavors of Brazil. This tart is perfect for warm weather and can be made in under an hour.

ingredients.name: Almond flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a fine ground almond flour for the best results

ingredients.name: Tart filling (see below for ingredients)
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of filling to your liking

ingredients.name: Earthy chocolate chips (at least 85% cocoa)
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality chocolate for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Brazilian coffee
ingredients.notes: Use freshly brewed coffee for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Heavy cream
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of cream to your liking

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the almond flour, granulated sweetener, and a pinch of salt.
Add in the melted butter and mix until the mixture is crumbly.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake the crust for 18-20 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
While the crust is baking, prepare the tart filling by melting the chocolate chips in a double boiler.
Remove the crust from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Pour the tart filling over the crust and smooth out the top.
Bake the tart for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool completely.
Once cooled, top the tart with whipped cream and serve.
